deployment_rules.facets: CREATE3 via FactoryServices; ArtifactCreationCode.releaseSalt binds namespace, creation code and constructor hash
deployment_rules.packages: manager deployPkg/register path via FactoryServices; constructor PkgInit encodes addresses of actual role facets and dependencies
deployment_rules.instances: manager deployVault with canonical ABI PkgArgs; package calcSalt determines instance salt
deployment_rules.v4_detf_prediction: calcSalt canonicalizes hook to zero; hook bound to predicted DETF with exactly one self-leg; register actual hook and verify owner/policy
deployment_rules.hooks: Hook callback factory plus mined nonce; actual required permission bits must match hook type
deployment_rules.linking: Factory ArtifactCreationCode rejects unresolved library placeholders; final artifact checks required

scope_exclusions: D60 Balancer-hosted DETFs (Balancer SE and V4 Balancer hooks retained)
units: DETF/sDETF/raw SY/static staking SY nine decimals; retained SE shares and underlying tokens keep actual native decimals.
